nodes.name: 素材输入
nodes.purpose: Normalize deployment input into RawSource records.
nodes.failure_behavior: Fail the workflow on malformed or unsupported source input.

nodes.name: 统一蒸馏
nodes.purpose: Run common extraction and the selected Creator plugin in one DistillationEngine invocation.
nodes.failure_behavior: Fail visibly on plugin loading, extraction, or shared Schema errors.

nodes.name: Creator插件增强
nodes.purpose: Verify the plugin enhancement already materialized inside the single unified distillation run; never run a second distillation pass.
nodes.failure_behavior: Fail when artifact plugin identity differs from runtime configuration.

nodes.name: Quality Gate
nodes.purpose: Convert common, domain, and risk evaluation into an enforced PASS or FAIL decision.
nodes.failure_behavior: Return FAIL and prevent the generation condition from evaluating true.

nodes.name: 内容生成
nodes.purpose: Hand a gate-approved GenerationRequest to the deployment-provided generation adapter boundary.
nodes.failure_behavior: Skip on FAIL; fail visibly if invoked without a PASS decision.
